name: @openlance/aios-marketing-intelligence
description: Phase 5 Stage 1 Marketing Intelligence: the first AI Growth OS Feature, a deterministic domain subsystem that owns the marketing-intelligence behavior only (ADR-0049). It consumes knowledge-owned marketing strategy, brand, customer, competitor, product, and company truth by canonical reference, and frames a governed platform task: an immutable MarketingBrief carrying the frozen Agent Engine AgentRequest (retrieval, prompt, provider steps), plus a marketing EvaluationRequest for the frozen Evaluation Engine. It is deterministic and fail-closed; it never owns, redefines, or writes business truth, never executes, invokes a provider, selects a model, authorizes, or decides, and builds no new platform infrastructure.
